message: So, I’ve been saying for ages that it’s good to have a fire safety plan in place, and guess what? The U.S. Fire Administration has some really helpful tips on preventing home fires. 🔥 It’s always nice to have a few resources for keeping our homes safe and cozy. Just think of it as one more way to keep the peace in our little corner of the world. Have you ever thought about what you’d do in a fire emergency?
